title: Session 2026-11-03, buyer clicks found broken, 7 satellites, 32 question pages, AI-cited hub extended
verdict: MCP revenue is still $0 and Stripe could not be read (live key needs stripe login). Worker logs show assistants answering in Japanese and Chinese writing our buy links into their answers, and 24 of 25 of those clicks died on a 404 because auto-linking glued punctuation onto the URL. That is the only buyer-intent stream ever measured, so the fix is PR #116, waiting to ship with the s1102m billing release. mcpstamp.com is indexed (the 0-indexed figure was the sitemap report's broken field), impressions rose 6 to 73 a day, and the one page-one page is a can-Claude question, so 12 more of those went live, each answered with a real call to a live server. Five new data satellites (CPI inflation, IRS mileage and per diem, silver price, river levels, SAT percentiles) took the free set to 25. Wave 2: a fresh blind test (R9, 10 of 18 named an estate server) showed assistants cite claudecodeguides.com/mcp/ pages and never found a satellite, so all 27 satellites now have pages there (PR #10, CI green, 27 of 27 live). Two more satellites feed the highest-traffic sites (recipetool, ingredientcalculator). A live RAP calculator bug (wrong cheapest plan, overstated PSLF rule) was fixed and republished. The buy-link fix is proven against the exact live billing source but needs stripe login to pass the deploy gate. Wave 3: a double opt-in update list now runs on mcpstamp.com through Resend (tested end to end, 0 subscribers yet), which is the consented outreach channel. mcp.zovo.one's 21 broken README links, 404 demo gifs and the misdescribed /recover link are fixed in PR #119; like #116 they ship with the next billing deploy, which needs stripe login.
